author: VOfficial404

description.zh-Hans: 在运行时上启动 JupyterLab，映射到 127.0.0.1:8888。
description.zh-Hant: 在執行階段上啟動 JupyterLab，對應到 127.0.0.1:8888。

script:
# JupyterLab on the runtime, at 127.0.0.1:8888. Fields arrive as COLAUNCH_<KEY>.
set -euo pipefail
( while true; do touch "$COLAUNCH_BUSY"; sleep 30; done ) &
BUSY=$!
trap 'kill "$BUSY" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT

echo "@@PHASE install@@"
python3 -m pip install -q jupyterlab
kill "$BUSY" 2>/dev/null || true
trap - EXIT
echo "@@PHASE start@@"
# Colab runs as root, which Jupyter refuses without --allow-root.
exec jupyter lab --no-browser --allow-root --ip=127.0.0.1 --port=8888 \
  --ServerApp.token="$COLAUNCH_TOKEN" --ServerApp.root_dir=/content
readme:
# JupyterLab

Installs JupyterLab with pip and serves /content on 127.0.0.1:8888, behind the token of the field.
